exploratory_A.scope: growth/structure exploration only; not quantitative transport validation
exploratory_A.registration_context: after known M0 noise audit, before new refined M1 outcome; engineering screening, not physical accuracy theorem
exploratory_A.detection_time_tolerance: max(2 coarse dt, 2% coarse detection time)
exploratory_A.justification: 5% distinguishes robust exploratory growth/shape from protocol-dependent changes; 0.1% surface-state agreement is stricter for mean background; noise must be at least 1000 times smaller than resolved perturbation, following the existing relative symmetry margin. These criteria do not bound tiny paired flux error.
required: retain absolute M0 gate as historical failed
paired timestep sensitivity does not cover signal
vertical and horizontal and domain errors bounded

timing_rule: Use exactly shared coarse/fine accepted times where available. Endpoint gaps must be reported and bounded with local conservative flux; no interpolation of cumulative flux.
